fieldValues.title: P8: Conformance
fieldValues.summary: Conformance concept and the declaration form stated first, the generated index last (X1's treatment); bridges invariant to validation, found unconnected; writes the missing 'How to decide which extensions to implement' leaf; deletes the empty 'Future Extensions' leaf. Concepts getting prose: Conformance, Invariant, Validation, Extension.
fieldValues.body:
Part unit from the read-through (§4, unit P8; findings §2 Part 8). Depends on X1, P7.

Landed via the-greenman/srs#848 (merged 2026-09-27). Wrote the empty "How to decide which extensions to implement" design-note; deleted the empty "Future Extensions" leaf (and an orphaned trailing separator left in "Graceful degradation" by that deletion, found on read-through); bridged Invariant and Validation in prose both ways; reordered part-conformance via ordering.memberOrder (ruling A) to put Conformance + the declaration form first and Extension after it, fixing the forward reference the read-through named. Invariant was re-parented from the Conformance concept to a direct child of the Part (Door 1, RFC-042 Change A) because check-spec-rendered-order.mjs found it depends on both Extension and Validation (not the reverse), so it renders last, after both. Counts: whole document 7,162 lines, 65,536 -> 65,742 words; Part-conformance container 32 -> 31 members; coherence 2/2, readability 50/50, rendered-order 7/7 allowlisted, all unchanged. All gates green (validate-all x2, check-release-drift, repo validate 0 errors).
